name: Cotton
description: Crucial commercial fibre crop of India ('White Gold'), widely grown in Maharashtra, Gujarat, Telangana, and Karnataka. Highly vulnerable to the bollworm complex (especially Pink Bollworm), sucking pests, and moisture stress during boll bursting.
climate: Semi-arid tropical and subtropical climate with long frost-free period, high temperature, and abundant sunshine.

soil.drainage_requirement: Good internal drainage required; water stagnation causes sudden square drop and root rots.
soil.organic_matter_requirement: Medium (>0.5% OC); apply 10 tonnes/ha FYM before monsoon.

planting_seasons: Central & South India: June - July (onset of South-West monsoon)
Tamil Nadu Winter Cambodia: August - September
seed_rate_per_ha: 2.0-2.5 kg/ha for Bt Cotton hybrids; 10-15 kg/ha for desi varieties.

growth_stages.description: Emergence of cotyledonary leaves and early taproot establishment.
critical_activities: Seed treatment with Imidacloprid against early sucking pests

growth_stages.description: Monopodial (vegetative) and sympodial (fruiting) branch expansion; emergence of flower buds ('squares').
critical_activities: Installation of Pheromone traps for Pink Bollworm (8 traps/acre)

growth_stages.description: Blooms turn from white/cream to pink; rapid boll enlargement and seed hair lint formation.
critical_activities: Foliar spray of 1% MgSO4 + 1% Urea to prevent leaf reddening
Monitor rosette flowers for Pink Bollworm

growth_stages.description: Boll carpels dry, split open, and expose fluffy white seed cotton (kapas).
critical_activities: Stop all irrigation 15 days before bursting
Hand picking in clean cloth bags; avoid bract contamination
vulnerabilities: Late boll rot in damp weather

irrigation.frequency_days: Every 12-15 days in black soils; every 8-10 days in red soils

nutrients.basal_application: Full P2O5 (60 kg) + 20% N (24 kg) + 30% K2O (18 kg) at sowing.
top_dressing_schedule: 50% N (60 kg) + 35% K2O (21 kg) at square formation (40-45 DAS)
30% N (36 kg) + 35% K2O (21 kg) at flowering and boll setting (70-75 DAS)
micronutrient_requirements: Foliar spray of 1% Magnesium sulphate + 0.5% Zinc sulphate at 50 and 80 DAS to combat leaf reddening

common_diseases: Bacterial Blight / Angular Leaf Spot (Xanthomonas citri pv. malvacearum)

maturity_indices: Bolls fully open and burst with fluffy clean white cotton
Picking done when moisture has evaporated from dew
harvesting.harvesting_method: Manual hand picking of clean bolls without leaf bracts.
harvesting.average_yield_per_ha: 2.0 - 3.2 tonnes/ha kapas under irrigated hybrid management
harvesting.post_harvest_care: Sun dry harvested seed cotton to reduce moisture below 8%; grade by staple length and color before sending to ginning mills.
